title: A jaw with a pivot
hook: A joint constrains the movements a model can make.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: The second picture shows the lower bar rotating around the same marked pivot. A real jaw can be more complex; fossils and joint geometry help constrain possible motion but do not show every soft tissue detail.

misconception: A jaw joint places no constraint on modeled jaw motion.
objective: In this toy jaw model, the lower jaw rotates around one fixed pivot. Which motion does the model allow?

recall.question: A toy bar is pinned at one end. Which motion keeps that pin fixed?
options: Detaching the bar without changing the pin
Rotating the bar around the pin
Moving the pin with the far end
recall.why: A fixed pin lets the bar rotate around that point in this toy model.
